description: Enrich an upstream DataFrame of job records (title + location) with PayScale Jobalyzer compensation-benchmark columns -- one API lookup per row. Requires payscale_resource; PayScale credentials are NOT self-serve.

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with job title and location columns

outputs.description: Input DataFrame with appended PayScale compensation-benchmark columns

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with job title/location data

job_title_column.label: Job Title Column
job_title_column.description: Column with the job title to send as PayScale's 'JobTitle' compensable factor

country_column.label: Country Column
country_column.description: Optional column with country name ('Country'). Falls back to default_country when absent or blank.

default_country.label: Default Country
default_country.description: Country sent when country_column is unset or blank for a row.

years_experience_column.label: Years Experience Column
years_experience_column.description: Optional column with years of experience ('YearsExperience')

education_column.label: Education Column
education_column.description: Optional column with highest degree earned ('HighestDegreeEarned')

skills_column.label: Skills Column
skills_column.description: Optional column with a comma-separated or list-valued set of skills ('Skills')

auto_resolve_job_title.label: Auto Resolve Job Title
auto_resolve_job_title.description: Let PayScale auto-match free-text JobTitle input to a standardized PayScale title.

include_total_pay.label: Include Total Pay
include_total_pay.description: Also append TotalPayReport columns alongside BasePayReport.

output_column_prefix.label: Output Column Prefix
output_column_prefix.description: Prefix applied to every appended compensation-benchmark column.

continue_on_error.label: Continue On Error
continue_on_error.description: If a row's PayScale lookup fails, log a warning and leave that row's columns null rather than failing the whole asset.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'multi' for date × static. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['python'] if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream input columns it derives from.

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (rows as a markdown table).
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: PayScale Compensation Enrichment
